name.ja: PG UNLEASHED 1/60 RX-78-2 ガンダム

description.ja: • 〈GUNPLA EVOLUTION LINK SYSTEM〉では段階的組み立て工程を採用、本物のMSを建造する疑似体験を演出。
description.en: • ``GUNPLA EVOLUTION LINK SYSTEM'' uses a step-by-step assembly process to create a simulated experience of building a real MS.

description.ja: • 「組立」「可動」「構造」「外装」「演出」と組み立てフェイズごとにガンプラ最新技術を凝縮し、ガンプラの進化を体感できる設計。
description.en: • Designed to allow you to experience Gunpla's evolution by condensing Gunpla's latest technology in each assembly phase: "assembly ", " movable ", " structure ", " exterior ", and " direction".

description.ja: • ガンプラ史上最大級、脚部全長約180mmのインサートフレームを採用。骨となる全身のフレームをPG史上最も早い段階で組み上げられる仕様となっている。
description.en: • Adopts Gunpla's largest insert frame in history, with a total leg length of approximately 180mm. It has a specification that allows the frame of the whole body, which is the bones, to be assembled at the earliest stage in the history of PG.

description.ja: • ガンプラ史上最大の全身90箇所以上に可動軸を設定。コア・ブロック機構を採用した胴体部は、40箇所の可動軸を組み合わせた新構造を採用。
description.en: • The largest movable axis in Gunpla history at over 90 locations throughout the body. The body uses a core block mechanism, with a new structure that combines 40 movable axes.

description.ja: • 多重構造のトラスフレームにはメタリック成形色とメッキパーツを採用し、4種の金属感を演出。
description.en: • The multi-layered truss frame uses metallic molding colors and plated parts to create four types of metallic feel.

description.ja: • シルバーメッキ、艶消しメッキ、クロームメッキなどの3種の二次加工や金属パーツ、新開発エッチングシールなど多彩なマテリアルを使用。
description.en: • A variety of materials are used, including three types of secondary processing such as silver plating, matte plating, and chrome plating, metal parts, and newly developed etched seals.

description.ja: • ガンプラ史上最多の全身のハッチオープンギミック搭載。
description.en: • Equipped with the largest number of whole body hatch opening gimmicks in Gunpla history.

description.ja: • 稼働シーンを演出する新規LEDユニットを搭載。色調変化を可能にする小型の新規RGB2灯式LEDライトと導光効率を最大限に引き出す設計により、可動と発光を両立。
description.en: • Equipped with a new LED unit that creates a working scene. A new compact RGB 2-lamp LED light that enables color tone changes and a design that maximizes light guiding efficiency achieves both movability and light emission.

description.ja: • 1/60スケールのビーム・サーベル内に、極小の電飾ユニットを搭載。成形材料の調合を追求したビーム刃により、実際に基部からビームが出力されたような鮮やかなグラデーション発光を実現。
description.en: • A very small illumination unit is installed inside the 1/60 Scale beam saber. The beam blade has been designed with a carefully selected blend of molding materials to create a bright gradation of light that looks like the beam is actually being emitted from the base.

description.ja: • 発光再現にはピン型リチウム電池BR435（テスト用１個付属）と、ボタン電池［LR41］（別売り）2個が必要です。
description.en: • To reproduce the light emission, a pin type lithium battery BR435 (one for testing is included) and two button batteries [LR41] (sold separately) are required.

accessories.en: Hand parts (left and right) x 4 types each

accessories.en: Figures x 4 types (Amuro [standing, sitting x 2], Sayla [standing])

ピン型リチウム電池BR435（テスト用）×１
accessories.en: Pin type lithium battery BR435 (for testing) x 1
